text:
samantha: Heads-up — AuroraHealth hosted account shows a spend jump this week vs their monthly commit. Dashboard flagged 3.2x expected spend for the 24h window. latency looks normal but error rate up ~0.9% -> 1.6%. Can we triage before renewal ping?

ajay: Looking now. Which key / route?

samantha: route: `/v1/generate` (api-key ending in -ah). I clipped the chart: peak around 03:00 UTC yesterday. total tokens billed: 1.8M daily, commit is 500k/day equivalent.

marc: I pulled the commit config — AuroraHealth has a monthly committed tokens = 15M (500k/day average). Their hosted plan also allows burst but shouldn't exceed commit without billing alerts on.

monitor-bot: alert: hosted_spend_anomaly: account=aurorahealth severity=high window=24h ratio=3.2 threshold=2.0

olivia: Could be onboarding test ingestion. They onboarded new NER pipeline last week using our streaming SDK. Any chance of an infinite loop or retry storms?

ben: I checked logs — there are repeated retry sequences from the same source IP 34.98.21.7. Pattern: client retried non-2xx every 5s for ~6 hours. Sample snippet: ```json
{"ts":"2026-02-26T03:12:11Z","status":502,"route":"/v1/generate","latency_ms":48,"api_key_suffix":"-ah"}
```

jess: I have a customer-facing call with them tomorrow at 16:00 PT. I can raise this and ask them to pause or rotate the key if needed. Want us to confirm root cause first?

ajay: Quick triage steps: 1) confirm burst policy + billing rules 2) block/rotate compromised key 3) check SDK version and streaming retry logic 4) propose temporary quota limit on account. I can do 1 & 2 now.

marc: On billing — their account has `auto-billing=true` and no hard cap. We will incur overage unless we intervene. Recommend we set a temporary soft cap and notify CS + PM.

olivia: Also check whether their integration is hitting `streaming=true` with small chunks (many calls) vs batching. If onboarding sample uses per-message calls, cost balloons.

ben: Confirmed the key is used from 3 distinct hosts with same user-agent `Aurora-Importer/1.2`. Two hosts are legit (their staging infra), one IP looked like a third-party crawler. I recommend rotate the key and ask them to redeploy.

samantha: Action list: ajay -> set temporary quota (limit to 800k/day) + rotate blocking on suspicious key; ben -> collect 1h x-request logs and blacklist IP if malicious; jess -> mention on tomorrow call and schedule follow-up; olivia -> prepare onboarding checklist (batching tips + SDK upgrade). I'll draft the customer message.

jess: fine with that. I'll ask them to pause ingestion for 12h and share logs. Also I'll request their expected weekly token volume to re-evaluate commit.

marc: FYI finance: if they exceed commit this month the overage will be billed at published rates. I'll CC billing once we rotate key so we can reconcile.

monitor-bot: incident_note: mitigation_started by ajay at 1801234589

ajay: Temporary quota applied (800k/day) and suspected key disabled at 1801234595. Leaving a short rate-limit so the UI doesn't break.

ben: Uploaded extracted logs to secure share: https://redwood.internal/s/aurorahealth-spike-logs (redwood SSO required). IP 34.98.21.7 has 72k requests in 6h.

samantha: Thanks team. I'll send a short proactive note to the customer with next steps and CC billing. We should also add a short onboarding doc line about batching unit tests. Drafting now -> ping when done and I'll send. :thumbsup:

jess: Ping me once draft is ready, I'll tailor for the call.

samantha: Draft done and posted to thread: ```Hi AuroraHealth team — we observed an unexpected spike in hosted API usage tied to an ingestion job. We've temporarily limited calls to reduce overage risk and disabled a suspicious API key. Please pause any bulk ingestion jobs, rotate your key, and join our call tomorrow at 4pm PT so we can review logs and adjust your commit if needed.```

jess: Sent to customer at 14:02 PT. They replied: "Thanks, will pause and rotate. We'll join the call."

marc: Closing note for this thread: mark as `high-risk-overage` until we confirm resumed stable behavior.

samantha: Marked. Follow-ups: check post-call metrics and reconcile billing impacts.

ben: I'll re-run log scan in 24h and report token delta.

monitor-bot: closed: mitigation_phase -> monitoring at 1801234699
